reviews.author: Пациент
reviews.text: Good morning. I had a consultation with neurologist Igor Shtuchniy in Novi Sad. The consultation went very well and lasted a little over an hour. Igor is an attentive neurologist: he took a full history, performed all neurological tests, and confirmed the diagnosis. He gave detailed conclusions and recommended further examination. I know migraine with aura is not cured completely, but so far attacks have not recurred. I recommend this specialist — he is also very pleasant to talk to.

reviews.author: Пациент
reviews.text: Today I was seen by neurologist Igor Shtuchniy. I can confidently recommend him. He strictly follows evidence-based medicine, takes a detailed history, does not recommend anything unnecessary or extra procedures, is polite and attentive, and explains everything in detail. You can feel professionalism and medical ethics.

reviews.text: Yesterday I was seen by neurologist Igor Shtuchniy. I was very pleased with his professionalism, attentiveness, and humanity. It is clear that the doctor loves his profession and approaches his work with genuine interest.
